d: Has America's military supremacy been shaken by the Iran war? In this exclusive conversation with Firstpost's Hem Kaur Saroya, Col. (Retd.) Douglas MacGregor, PhD, former Senior Advisor to the US Secretary of Defense, examines Washington's military setbacks and its increasingly fragile global position. He argues that America's attempts to reassert military dominance have failed, while its actions against Iran are hurting allies across the world. MacGregor also discusses America's financial vulnerabilities, the growing resistance from Russia and China, and why Washington may need to rethink…
